item.title: Custom tick marks with R's base graphics system
item.description:
This post was first published on August 29, 2020, on the old blog (https://bloglegay_axis.insileco.io/2020/08/29/custom-tick-marks-with-rs-base-graphics-system/). We believe it has been useful to R users and decided to review its content and translate it into French.

Context
